Name: Claude Notify
Author: McTonnie
Description: Flashes, counts and chimes when a Claude Code session in the Claude Desktop app needs your answer or has finished. One press opens that session.

Actions.Name: Needs answer
Actions.Tooltip: Flashes when a Claude session waits for your answer or approval. Press: open the next one. Hold: dismiss all.

Actions.Name: Finished
Actions.Tooltip: Flashes when a Claude session has finished its task. Press: open the oldest. Hold: dismiss all.

Actions.Name: Combined
Actions.Tooltip: Both in one key: amber half = needs answer, green half = finished. Press: needs first, then finished. Hold: dismiss all.

Actions.Name: Mute
Actions.Tooltip: Turns all Claude Notify sounds off or on. Set quiet hours in its settings.

Actions.Name: Session browser
Actions.Tooltip: Stream Deck +: turn to browse waiting Claude sessions, press or tap to open, hold a touch to dismiss.

Actions.Name: Session status
Actions.Tooltip: Stream Deck +: shows every busy Claude session (working, needs answer, finished) with its state and time. Turn to switch, press or tap to open.
